nodes.label: Gold-on-Dark Only Rule (gold-deep on cream)

nodes.label: Reem Kufi Only for Brand Name
nodes.norm_label: reem kufi only for brand name
nodes.rationale: Initial heh reads like meem in headings

nodes.label: Self-hosted Fonts (not Google Fonts)
nodes.rationale: Google Fonts may be slow or unavailable from Iran; Reem Kufi and Cinzel are OFL licensed

nodes.label: UI Rules (mobile-first 375px, logical RTL classes, Persian prices, empty/error states)

nodes.rationale: Most visits come from Instagram on phones

nodes.label: ilnia:cancel-unpaid-orders Command
nodes.rationale: Hourly; cancels orders older than UNPAID_ORDER_HOURS, re-verifying unresolved payments first

nodes.label: PaymentService (Zarinpal REST v4 via Laravel Http)
nodes.norm_label: paymentservice (zarinpal rest v4 via laravel http)
nodes.rationale: Direct Http instead of shetabit/payment because that package uses Guzzle directly and is not testable with Http::fake

nodes.label: SendOrderConfirmationSms Job
nodes.rationale: Queued so payment callback page does not wait for SMS

nodes.label: SmsService Interface (LogSmsDriver / KavenegarSmsDriver)
nodes.rationale: Template-based verify lookup is faster and more reliable for OTP; API key in URL so URL never logged

nodes.label: Gateway Disabled Mode (PaymentService::isEnabled)
nodes.rationale: Zarinpal gateway not yet obtained; empty ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID disables online payment and order creation

nodes.label: Single Cron Line schedule:run (queue, cancel orders, prune OTP)
nodes.norm_label: single cron line schedule:run (queue, cancel orders, prune otp)

nodes.label: Open Question: Kavenegar Template Variables (%token% assumed)

nodes.label: Rate Limits Table (OTP send/verify, admin login, retry, callback)
nodes.norm_label: rate limits table (otp send/verify, admin login, retry, callback)

nodes.label: Shared Hosting Constraints (no Node, no Redis/Supervisor, cron-driven queue)
nodes.norm_label: shared hosting constraints (no node, no redis/supervisor, cron-driven queue)
nodes.rationale: Host assumed to have SSH, Composer and cron but no Node/Redis; build frontend locally, use database queue/cache/session

nodes.label: TRUSTED_PROXIES behind CDN
nodes.rationale: Without it all visitors share CDN IP and OTP rate limit fills for everyone

nodes.label: Admin Access via User::canAccessPanel / is_admin / ilnia:make-admin
nodes.norm_label: admin access via user::canaccesspanel / is_admin / ilnia:make-admin

nodes.label: SecurityHeaders Middleware (no CSP yet)
nodes.rationale: CSP deferred because Livewire/Alpine use inline scripts and a wrong CSP breaks checkout

nodes.label: Document Root Methods (A: public/, B: public_html with usePublicPath)
nodes.norm_label: document root methods (a: public/, b: public_html with usepublicpath)

nodes.label: Minimum Host PHP 8.4.1 / config.platform.php
nodes.rationale: Symfony dependencies in composer.lock require 8.4.1

nodes.label: Phase 4: Launch Preparation (open: code review, host PHP check, real gateway, Kavenegar templates)
nodes.norm_label: phase 4: launch preparation (open: code review, host php check, real gateway, kavenegar templates)

nodes.label: OrderPricing::quote() -> OrderTotals
nodes.rationale: Single source of order amount so displayed and stored totals never diverge

nodes.label: OrderService::createFromCart
nodes.rationale: Creates pending_payment order in a transaction with snapshots; refuses if cart changed on reconciliation; does not decrement stock

nodes.label: Fixed Tech Stack (PHP 8.5 + Laravel + Livewire + Filament + Tailwind)
nodes.norm_label: fixed tech stack (php 8.5 + laravel + livewire + filament + tailwind)
nodes.rationale: Monolith chosen because owner has little programming knowledge, shared hosting, ready-made admin panel; no React/Vue/Inertia/separate API

nodes.label: Later Backlog (blog, discount codes, real-buyer reviews, Basalam/Torob)
nodes.norm_label: later backlog (blog, discount codes, real-buyer reviews, basalam/torob)

nodes.norm_label: user answers 2026-11-11 (php, sms, shipping, product, price, gateway, host)

nodes.label: Small Understandable Steps / Standard Laravel Way
nodes.norm_label: small understandable steps / standard laravel way
nodes.rationale: Project owner has limited programming knowledge; avoid clever solutions and exotic libraries

nodes.label: Order Snapshot Principle
nodes.rationale: Address, product name, variant title and price copied into order so later edits never alter past orders

nodes.label: Content Pages (about, contact, shipping, terms) via PageSeeder drafts
nodes.norm_label: content pages (about, contact, shipping, terms) via pageseeder drafts

nodes.label: SEO (layout meta, OG, schema.org Product in IRR, sitemap, robots)
nodes.norm_label: seo (layout meta, og, schema.org product in irr, sitemap, robots)

nodes.label: Photo Placeholder (cream box with Ilnia mark)
nodes.norm_label: photo placeholder (cream box with ilnia mark)

nodes.label: Honesty Rule in Site (no fake claims, reviews, stock photos)
nodes.norm_label: honesty rule in site (no fake claims, reviews, stock photos)
nodes.rationale: Brand value of honesty (sedaghat): no QR, lab sheet, trust badges, bestseller claims or fabricated reviews; placeholder until real product photos

nodes.label: Non-negotiable Security Rules
nodes.rationale: Secrets only in .env; amount computed server-side; server-side verify, idempotent; stock decremented with lock; OTP rate limits; admin-only /admin

nodes.label: Idempotent Payment Verify with lockForUpdate
nodes.rationale: Duplicate or concurrent callbacks must never record payment or decrement stock twice; codes 100/101 success

nodes.label: App\Filament\Forms\IntegerInput
nodes.rationale: Admin types with Persian keyboard; accepts Persian digits and separators, stores integer

nodes.label: App\Support\Jalali (IntlDateFormatter)
nodes.rationale: intl is required by Filament anyway, avoiding an extra package

nodes.label: OrderStatus Enum (pending_payment -> paid -> processing -> shipped -> delivered; payment_failed, cancelled, needs_attention)
nodes.norm_label: orderstatus enum (pending_payment -> paid -> processing -> shipped -> delivered; payment_failed, cancelled, needs_attention)
nodes.rationale: Admin may only change post-payment statuses; paid/payment_failed set only by payment flow

nodes.label: admin.css (Filament panel fonts, loaded by AdminPanelProvider)
nodes.norm_label: admin.css (filament panel fonts, loaded by adminpanelprovider)
nodes.rationale: Filament panel does not use the site Vite build, so a Vazirmatn copy lives in public/fonts

nodes.label: Order Number Format IL-yyMMdd-XXXX
nodes.rationale: Readable, usable as Kavenegar token, does not leak sales count

nodes.label: Code Rules (RTL Persian UI, integer Toman, Persian digits, Jalali dates, 09xx mobile)
nodes.norm_label: code rules (rtl persian ui, integer toman, persian digits, jalali dates, 09xx mobile)

nodes.label: CartService (session-based cart)
nodes.rationale: Session stores only variant_id->quantity; prices always from DB; reconciles with stock on every read; MAX_PER_ITEM 50

nodes.label: Data Model (users, otp_codes, categories, products, variants, orders, payments...)
nodes.norm_label: data model (users, otp_codes, categories, products, variants, orders, payments...)
nodes.rationale: Price and stock live on product_variants; each weight is a variant; nullable price means not purchasable
